# Metrics reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_docs.py from netdoctor.metrics; do not edit by hand. -->

Exposed in the Prometheus text format (version 0.0.4) by `netdoctor --watch --metrics-port PORT` at `/metrics`,
and written once per run by `netdoctor -f prometheus` (suitable for the node_exporter *textfile collector*).
Durations are in **seconds** and shares are **ratios (0..1)**, following Prometheus conventions.
Series are only exported for checks that actually ran.

| Metric | Type | Labels | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `netdoctor_build_info` | gauge | `version` | NetDoctor version information. |
| `netdoctor_runs_total` | counter | *(none)* | Diagnostic cycles started since the watcher began. |
| `netdoctor_run_errors_total` | counter | *(none)* | Cycles that failed with an internal error. |
| `netdoctor_last_success_timestamp_seconds` | gauge | *(none)* | Unix time of the last successful cycle. |
| `netdoctor_notifications_sent_total` | counter | *(none)* | Webhook notifications delivered. |
| `netdoctor_notifications_failed_total` | counter | *(none)* | Webhook notifications that failed after all retries. |
| `netdoctor_notifications_dropped_total` | counter | *(none)* | Webhook notifications dropped because the queue was full. |
| `netdoctor_target_status` | gauge | `target`, `status` | 1 for the target's current overall status, else 0. |
| `netdoctor_target_healthy` | gauge | `target` | 1 if the target is healthy (no warnings or failures). |
| `netdoctor_check_duration_seconds` | gauge | `target` | Wall time of the last full diagnosis. |
| `netdoctor_dns_ok` | gauge | `target` | 1 if the system resolver answered. |
| `netdoctor_dns_resolution_seconds` | gauge | `target` | System resolver lookup time. |
| `netdoctor_tcp_ok` | gauge | `target`, `port`, `family` | 1 if at least one TCP handshake succeeded. |
| `netdoctor_tcp_loss_ratio` | gauge | `target`, `port`, `family` | Share of failed TCP handshakes (0..1). |
| `netdoctor_tcp_connect_seconds` | gauge | `target`, `port`, `family` | Average TCP handshake time. |
| `netdoctor_tcp_jitter_seconds` | gauge | `target`, `port`, `family` | Mean absolute difference of consecutive handshake times. |
| `netdoctor_tls_ok` | gauge | `target` | 1 if the TLS handshake and certificate verification succeeded. |
| `netdoctor_tls_cert_expiry_days` | gauge | `target` | Days until the served certificate expires. |
| `netdoctor_tls_handshake_seconds` | gauge | `target` | TLS handshake time. |
| `netdoctor_http_ok` | gauge | `target` | 1 if an HTTP response was received. |
| `netdoctor_http_status_code` | gauge | `target` | Final HTTP status code. |
| `netdoctor_http_ttfb_seconds` | gauge | `target` | Time to first byte of the first request. |
| `netdoctor_icmp_ok` | gauge | `target` | 1 if ping received a reply. |
| `netdoctor_icmp_loss_ratio` | gauge | `target` | Share of lost ICMP echo requests (0..1). |
| `netdoctor_icmp_rtt_seconds` | gauge | `target` | Average ICMP round-trip time. |
| `netdoctor_finding` | gauge | `target`, `code`, `severity` | 1 for each active warning-or-worse finding. |

Ready-made alert rules: [`examples/prometheus-alerts.yml`](../examples/prometheus-alerts.yml).
